description:
Read one car auction's current public bid state; search_auctions discovers events and get_vehicle provides the linked car's facts.

- auction_id binds every bid and deadline to one sale event. Keep that event's listing link beside the result; a bid from another event or the car's retail asking price cannot fill a missing auction value.
- A saved event may have ended. Check status/end_at and refresh before answering a live-bid question; use minimum_next_bid only when returned.
- Anonymous snapshots can fail for feature gating, rate limits or unknown events. Report the error; reserve prices and bidder identities stay private. Bidding requires a verified dealer and a human decision outside this tool.

auction_id.description: Copy auction_id from search_auctions or an auction-linked get_vehicle result, or use a known public auction ID supplied by the buyer. Supply the event identifier alone, not a listing_id or URL; never invent one.

name: get_auction
title: Read public car auction status
